_comment: PROTOTYPE FIXTURE — the 8 W34 rows from data/notion-qualified-accounts-w34.csv, with the labels this screener is graded against. `expect` is the set of notice kinds the row must produce; [] means the screener must stay silent. `why` records the reasoning so a later reader cannot quietly relabel a row to make a run pass.

rows.notes: Priya is replacing a spreadsheet-based forecast. Asked whether implementation can start before the October planning cycle.
rows.why: Benign. Nothing about an earlier contact or an earlier campaign.

rows.notes: Referred by Vale Partners. UK team owns the evaluation, but procurement is based in Dublin. Wants a discovery call next week.
rows.why: Benign. A referring firm is not a prior contact with this person.

rows.notes: Met at Mobility Summit. Amina asked for the fleet partnerships deck. No work email was captured; LinkedIn is verified.
rows.why: Benign for screening. The missing work email is a deterministic Stop (B1), not a notice, and the screener must not restate it.

rows.notes: Lewis owns CRM hygiene and reporting. Their current process combines Pipedrive exports with a weekly agency spreadsheet.
Marta controls budget and joined the same evaluation as Lewis. Treat this as a second contact at the existing account, not a second opportunity.
rows.why: PRECISION TRAP. Tempting, and wrong. W1 already proves this duplicate deterministically from the shared domain; a notice on top of a decision Warn is noise on the one candidate the reviewer most needs to think about. ADR-0002: the note corroborates a fact the pipeline already holds, it does not supply one.

rows.notes: Emily attended the RevOps teardown webinar and requested the migration checklist. She previously spoke to the team under another email address.
rows.why: RECALL TARGET. Explicit earlier contact under a different email address.

rows.notes: Warm referral from Dani at North & Coast. Interested in replacing manual lead routing before hiring two additional SDRs.
rows.why: PRECISION TRAP. Names a person outside the batch, but says nothing about a prior contact with Soren or a prior campaign touching him.

rows.notes: Noor replied from a newer email alias. Their LinkedIn profile and role match a person already researched in the spring campaign.
rows.why: RECALL TARGET, and the co-occurrence case. Sentence one is N1 (a newer alias implies an earlier address); sentence two is N2. Graded as both — see the ticket's question 2.
